content.content: When invoked as `deccy log`, the deccy CLI shall list each node after every node it depends on or evaluates, taking next the smallest change id among the nodes whose prerequisites are all listed; a node that a cycle keeps from being listable follows the rest in ascending change id order; it shall settle no filtering.
content.rationale: Order is carried by the edges, so the listing follows the graph wherever it points; the smallest change id next makes the listing total and reproducible rather than merely partial. A cycle has no order, so whatever it keeps from being listed follows the rest in ascending change id order. Ordering is not querying: the read (txookpuq) and the no-filtering restraint stand.
